fields.description: Issue features prominent coverage of South Florida oil development with photographs and reporting on the Sunniland oil field and production constraints. Local political coverage includes Miami Beach municipal election issues and commentary. Additional reporting and opinion address crime and law enforcement controversies involving a Miami police officer, discussion of a Dade County judicial election connected to a divorce case, juvenile theft arrests, and assorted local business, entertainment, nightlife, and sports items and advertisements.
